description: This Java class implements the <field-to-request> element for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework, enabling the transfer of a field value into an HTTP request attribute within a method execution context.

classes.name: FieldToRequest
classes.description: Implements the <field-to-request> element, transferring a specified field value into an HTTP request attribute during method execution.

classes.name: FieldToRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToRequest.

methods.name: FieldToRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes, validating required attributes and setting up accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value from the environment map and sets it as a request attribute if conditions are met.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <field-to-request> element with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FieldToRequest instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'field-to-request'.
